      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "import yfinance as yf\n",
        "from datetime import datetime\n",
        "\n",
        "# Pengaturan format tampilan grafik\n",
        "sns.set_style('whitegrid')\n",
        "plt.style.use(\"fivethirtyeight\")\n",
        "%matplotlib inline\n",
        "\n",
        "# Daftar saham teknologi yang digunakan untuk analisis\n",
        "tech_list = ['AAPL', 'GOOG', 'MSFT', 'AMZN']\n",
        "\n",
        "# Menentukan waktu mulai dan akhir untuk pengambilan data\n",
        "end = datetime.now()\n",
        "start = datetime(end.year - 1, end.month, end.day)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Mengunduh data saham\n",
        "for stock in tech_list:\n",
        "    # PERBAIKAN: Menambahkan auto_adjust=False agar kolom 'Adj Close' tetap tersedia\n",
        "    globals()[stock] = yf.download(stock, start, end, auto_adjust=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "company_list = [AAPL, GOOG, MSFT, AMZN]\n",
        "company_name = [\"APPLE\", \"GOOGLE\", \"MICROSOFT\", \"AMAZON\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "for company, com_name in zip(company_list, company_name):\n",
        "    company[\"company_name\"] = com_name\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.concat(company_list, axis=0)\n",
        "df.tail(10)"
